summary: The parser rejected valid TOML datetimes with lowercase t or a space separator, and lowercase z offsets. The fix accepts those forms and constructs datetime values from parsed components. This reversal restores the uppercase-T-only separator restriction. Blocked on test selection: the checked-in Rust tests use uppercase T; the fix enables external compliance cases through the harness=false decoder_compliance target, but no full Rust test name demonstrating this regression could be established from the available source. No builds or tests were run.
